# AILedger

AILedger, PBC (Delaware public benefit corporation; CA dba AILEDGER, INC.) builds **Consilium**, the federated
context layer for AI agents in medical research.

- Agents run inside an institution's own environment (VPC or on-premises); clinical and genomic data never leaves.
- Every agent decision — conclusion, evidence, rejected alternatives, reviewer — is written to an append-only,
  SHA-256-chained record that verifies offline (RFC 8785 canonicalization; two byte-exact implementations; open source).
- Institutions can query one another's context without moving patient records: a question travels, counts and
  summaries return, and a node without coverage records an abstention.
- Institutional knowledge is structured on the open aDNA standard (MIT), so an agent loads the relevant subgraph
  rather than a corpus.
- Access is a policy setting: pro-bono or humanitarian participation is an authorization-scope change, not a
  separate product.

Deployment: 12-week founding-cohort engagement led by a forward-deployed engineer. Contact: jake@ailedger.dev.
Charter: https://ailedger.dev/charter/ · Source: https://github.com/ailedger-dev/ailedger · Standard: https://adna.network
